method_note: ADR-0005's decision: layer 3 encodes the candidate text and compares it to this versioned set of canonical reference utterances, and decides on the maximum cosine similarity to the attack references. Nearest-neighbour over explicit references rather than a learned head, because a reference can be shown to a reviewer and a threshold can be argued about; a classifier head cannot be either. The set was written from the attack taxonomy FIRST and the labelled corpus was written afterwards from realistic patient messages, so the corpus is not a paraphrase of these lines — it is measured against them, and it does not all fall inside their reach.
